anand-ps.name: Anand P S
anand-ps.bio: Engineer specializing in distributed backend architectures, embedded systems, firmware development, and production-grade software design. Builds efficient, fault-tolerant systems with a focus on scalability and long-term maintainability.

reva-pradeep.name: Reva Pradeep
reva-pradeep.bio: Product-focused professional with experience in business analysis and leading social initiatives. Combines analytical thinking with structured execution to drive outcomes. Brings a leadership mindset with a focus on problem-solving and impact.

nesrin-anwer.name: Nesrin Anwer
nesrin-anwer.bio: Electrical and electronics engineer integrating data analytics into system design. Focused on renewable energy, control systems, and signal processing. Driven by hands-on learning and structured problem-solving.

ameer-ts.name: Ameer T S
ameer-ts.bio: Electrical Engineer with hands-on experience in industrial and high-voltage systems. Skilled in PLC/SCADA, protective relays, transformers, and switchgear, with a strong focus on system reliability, preventive maintenance, and efficient operations.

sahal-mh.name: Muhammed Sahal M H
sahal-mh.bio: Electrical Engineer with maintenance experience across the manufacturing industry, along with experience in control panel assembly, diagnostics, and substation operations. Proven ability to resolve faults, and ensure reliable electrical system performance.

ananya-ajith.name: Ananya Ajith Kallungal
ananya-ajith.bio: Engineer skilled in machine learning, Python, and data-driven systems, with a background in electrical engineering. Focused on building scalable, efficient solutions while applying analytical models and system-level thinking to solve complex problems.

anagha-s.name: Anagha S
anagha-s.bio: Software developer with a strong focus on machine learning and video analytics. Combines analytical thinking with an artistic approach to build efficient and impactful solutions. Focused on clean architecture, problem-solving, and continuous technical growth.

sidharth-s.name: Sidharth S
sidharth-s.bio: Software developer specializing in distributed systems and scalable backend architecture. Experienced in building high-performance applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Go, with expertise in databases like Aerospike and ArangoDB. Focused on performance optimization, system reliability, and designing robust, production-grade solutions.

gopika-gopikrishnan.name: Gopika Gopikrishnan
gopika-gopikrishnan.bio: Specializing in Deep Learning for Signal Processing. Experienced in building frameworks for on-device learning for ultrasound systems. Skilled in Pytorch, Python, MATLAB.
